sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Documented CMake/CLI and all output packages validate; clean rebuild not independently repeated.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured mesh, zones, geometry and cell graph are source-evidenced.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual, Rusanov flux, farfield/slip/no-slip paths are source-evidenced.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ limiter and positivity source present, but session-backed M080/M200 viscous runs ended within 600-step piecewise-constant mode despite claimed second-order finals.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradients, Newtonian/Fourier terms and wall/tangential force treatment are evidenced.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS/local CFL and BDF source exist, but transient target ratios are measured with frozen reconstruction and are not rechecked after refresh; accepted-state strict compliance remains unknown.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/neighbor exchange and internally consistent np1/2/4 rank studies exist. np8 controls differ, so comparable np8 accuracy remains unproved.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Eight packages structurally validate, but M200 laminar force remains strongly nonstationary when marked converged; other cases remain under review.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report equations and tables exist, but rank Cd table is inaccurate, final second-order claim is contradicted by two session-bound runs, and wide-domain contours do not resolve the claimed wake or near-body shock.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Good modular 2-D structure and configurable BCs; 3-D/EOS/RANS/species remain future extensions.

flags.evidence: Historical np1/2/4 Re20 forces have final Cd 5.7061412154/5.7061412393/5.7061419853 and match one another; production np8 gives 1.9532115368. Thus the large difference cannot be attributed to rank count alone. Immutable report.tex:341–358 nevertheless pairs the rankcount steps/times with Cd 1.953 instead of the retained mpi_rank_summary.csv/forces values 5.706, a substantive reporting discrepancy. Full DQ review remains pending.
